issue_title: Streaming is broken and manual completion is broken
issue_body:
## Description

PR https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyter-ai/pull/553 broke streaming 

Some obvious errors are highlighted by mypy and other type checkers.

1. Argument missing for parameter "request"
   https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyter-ai/blob/6de20475d3f58e83903899b7d1a26cc317449556/packages/jupyter-ai/jupyter_ai/completions/handlers/default.py#L113-L114
2. function declared to return a value but returns `None`:
   https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyter-ai/blob/6de20475d3f58e83903899b7d1a26cc317449556/packages/jupyter-ai/jupyter_ai/completions/handlers/default.py#L76-L89
3. None is not awaitable - this is inifnite recursion:
    https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyter-ai/blob/6de20475d3f58e83903899b7d1a26cc317449556/packages/jupyter-ai/jupyter_ai/completions/handlers/base.py#L162-L165
4. The `stream` method was removed but is still called
    https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyter-ai/blob/6de20475d3f58e83903899b7d1a26cc317449556/packages/jupyter-ai/jupyter_ai/completions/handlers/base.py#L166


## Reproduce

1. Enable completions in Settings Editor
2. Type some code
3. Press Alt + `/` or change streaming setting to "always" and type anything

See error:


```python
Traceback (most recent call last):
File "jupyter_ai/completions/handlers/base.py", line 130, in handle_request_and_catch
   await handle_request
File "jupyter-ai/jupyter_ai/completions/handlers/base.py", line 165, in _handle_stream_request
   await self._handle_stream_request(request)
File "jupyter_ai/completions/handlers/base.py", line 165, in _handle_stream_request
   await self._handle_stream_request(request)
File "jupyter_ai/completions/handlers/base.py", line 165, in _handle_stream_request
  await self._handle_stream_request(request)
[Previous line repeated 2985 more times]
File "jupyter-ai/jupyter_ai/completions/handlers/base.py", line 164, in _handle_stream_request
   start = time.time()
RecursionError: maximum recursion depth exceeded while calling a Python object
```


## Expected behavior

It should work

## Context

[2.10.0beta0](https://github.com/jupyterlab/jupyter-ai/commit/6de20475d3f58e83903899b7d1a26cc317449556)
